original.text:
Presses

A thing being hit.

tap
Any button. By volume, the sound of the whole app.
select
A menu row, a tab, an option. Pitched by its place.
destructive
A destructive button. Lower and heavier, so it lands.
Toggles

Direction carries the state.

toggleOn
A switch, checkbox or toggle going on. It rises.
toggleOff
The same control going off. It falls.
Surfaces

Slower than a press, because the room changed.

open
A dialog, popover, accordion or menu arriving.
close
The surface leaving, or the button that shuts it.
swoosh
The press that ends and shuts the surface. Also unmute.
Values

Nearly subliminal, because they repeat.

tick
Taking hold of a slider, or stepping a value.
sliderTick
Every value a drag passes through. The quietest here.
key
Each digit of a one-time code, pitched by its position.
Outcomes

The only cues allowed to be a phrase.

success
Two notes, upward. It resolves.
error
Two notes, downward. It does not.
warning
The same note twice. It insists.
Named

Asked for by a control through data-sound.

copy
Taken to the clipboard. Two clicks, like a shutter.
notification
The interface changing under you: the theme swapping.
chirp
Clearing a field or chip, or one step into the palette.
command
Running a palette command. The other half of chirp.
blocked
A press that will not be answered. Dead on purpose.
